I’ve visited this groomers a few times now, and while they do a decent job overall, there are a few important things to point out. The place is very small, you can barely walk in with your dog, which makes the experience a bit uncomfortable. The service is okay, nothing particularly outstanding.

What really concerned me was what happened after my last visit. The day after, my dog kept scratching his ear non-stop, and when I checked, I found a big piece of cotton buried inside. That was very worrying and something I didn’t expect.

Another inconvenience is that they only accept cash. It’s frustrating in this day and age when most places offer more flexible payment methods.

Unfortunately, because of this experience, I won’t be taking my dog there again.
